verdict.rationale: The product is a set of agent-oriented markdown documents: SKILL.md files served raw from GitHub, ADRs under .agents/, and a CONTEXT.md glossary meant for agents. A hands-on probe confirmed an agent can fetch and install them, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable material. However, there is no llms.txt or dedicated agent-facing documentation index, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint (skills.md) returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, an agent-oriented docs entry point for the project's own documentation, and independent corroboration of agents consuming the docs directly.
